intro: Mauritius is a volcanic island ringed by coral reefs, about 2,000 km off Africa.

chapters.title: Island
text: Black River Gorges has rainforest with rare birds like the pink pigeon. Le Morne Brabant is a mountain on a lagoon. Rodrigues and other islands also belong to Mauritius.

chapters.title: Cyclones
text: Cyclones can hit in summer, from November to April.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Mauritius' landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
